purpose: Index the repository files, derived release evidence, and local proprietary inputs needed to continue the corrected runtime animation pipeline without guessing layout or reusing deprecated motion/static classifications.
public_release_exclusions: SMZ, OGG, PCM, DGM, CRI, MP4, screenshots, and extracted game media
large rendered videos before final publishing review
pipeline_constraints: keep native resolution and frame rate
do not regenerate the deprecated 124GB 1080p output
do not use deprecated motion/static classification
do not infer CRI index directly from ac suffix numbers
do not mix subtitle and no-subtitle editions
separate slot/material effects from clean audience story animations
